verses.text: Ix smolb'an masanil heb' yetisraelal winhaj Moisés, ix yalan winh t'a heb': Hex wetchonhab', ab'ek wal tikne'ik, ol walkan juntzanh kachnab'il yet' cheknab'il t'ayex, yik scham wal he k'ayb'ani yet' he b'eyb'alani.
Ha Jehová ko Diosal yak'nak jun strato ket'ok t'a lum witz skuchan Horeb.
Manhoknhej yet' heb' ko mam kicham yak'nak strato chi', palta yak'nakpax ket'ok ko masanil ha honh molan honh ek' tik.
Ha wal Jehová lolonnak t'ayonh t'a jolom witz chi', kab'nak wal tas yal chi' ayik slolonelta t'a kal k'ak'.
Ha hin kan hin t'a he nanhal yet' Jehová chi' yik swal t'ayex tas syala', yujto hex xiwk'e t'a jun k'ak' chi', maj hex k'e t'a jolom witz chi', yalan Jehová chi' icha tik:
Ha hin Jehová he Diosal hin, hex wik'elta t'a Egipto b'aj ayex och chekab'ok, manh heyikok he b'a.
Malajokab' junokxo Dios b'aj tzex och ejmelal, palta anhejokab' t'ayin.
Malajokab' junok yechel junok tas tze b'o'och he diosalok, tas ay t'a satcha'anh, tas ay t'a sat lum tik, ma tastak ay t'a yoltak ha ha'.

Manh hex em nhojan t'ay, manh heyak'em he b'a t'ay, yujto ha hin Jehová he Diosal hin, ste kot wowal t'ayex tato tzex och ejmelal t'a junokxo tasi. Ol wak'och syahelal heb' mamab'il malaj welk'och t'ay, ol wak'anpax yahelal t'a yib'anh yuninal heb', yixchikin heb' yet' yinhtilal heb'.
Haxo heb' tzin xajanani, sk'anab'ajan hin cheknab'il, ol hin xajanej heb' yet' yinhtilal yik ol b'eynhejb'atok.
Manh komonok tze lok hin b'i ha hin Jehová he Diosal hin tik, ma tzeyak' b'inaj hin b'i t'a junok tas t'a ichnhej ta', yujto ol wak' yahelal t'a mach icha chi' sk'ulej.
Niwanokab' yelk'och sk'uhal ik'oj ip t'ayex yuj hin heyik'ancha'anh, icha ix aj walankan t'ayex.
Wake' k'uhal tzex munlaj t'a he munlajel.

Haxo t'a yukil k'uhal, sk'uhal ik'oj ip, wik yaji. Manh hex munlaj t'a jun k'u chi', ma heb' heyuninal, heb' ix heyisil, heb' winh he chekab', ma heb' ix he chekab', nok' he wakax, nok' he chej, ma junokxo nok' he molb'etzal nok', ma heb' ch'ok chonhab'il ayek' t'a he kal, palta masanil heb' syik' yip heyet'ok.
Na'ekkoti to ek'nakex chekab'wumal t'a Egipto. Ha hinxo Jehová he Diosal hin tik wik'nakexelta yet' hin poder. Yuj chi' swala' to tze k'anab'ajej sk'uhal ik'oj ip.
Ayokab' yelk'och he mam he nun t'a he sat, icha wal ix aj walan t'ayex, yik wach' ol najatb'ok he k 'inal, yik wach' ol hex ajek' t'a sat lum lum ol wak' chi' t'ayex.
Manh he milcham heb' heyetanima'il.
Manh hex em ajmulal t'a yol sk'ab' heyetb'eyum junjun hex.
Manh hex elk'anok.
Manh he nak'e lolonel t'a spatik heb' heyetanima'il.

Manh he nib'ejoch ix yetb'eyum junokxo mach, spat, slu'um, heb' winh schekab', heb' ix schekab', nok' swakax, nok' sb'uru, ma junokxo tas ay t'a heb' heyetanima'il chi', manh he nib'ejochi, xchi Jehová t'ayonh.

Haton wal juntzanh cheknab'il tik te cha'anh ajnak yalanelta Jehová t'a skal jun niwan k'ik'al asun ayoch sk'ak'al, ayik molan honh ek' ko masanil t'a yich lum witz chi'. Anhej wal juntzanh cheknab'il tik yalnak, ichato chi' stz'ib'anoch t'a chab' pachanh k'e'en k'e'en, yak'an t'ayin.

Palta ha hexxo tik, ayik heyab'an yoch jun jaj chi' t'a skal k'ik' k'inal chi', heyilan sk'e nhilnhon k'ak' t'a lum witz chi', masanil hex yajal heyaj t'a junjun heyinhtilal tik yet' heb' yichamtak winakil chonhab', hex jawi heyal t'ayin icha tik:

Wal yel, ha Jehová ko Diosal ix sch'ox wal stzikiki'al yet' yipalil t'ayonh, ix kab' wal slolon t'a skal k'ak'. Ha tikne'ik toxo ix nachaj wal el ku'uj tob'an syal slolon Dios t'ayonh anima honh tik, palta ina maj honh chamlaj.
¿Tas yuj sko b'ek ko b'a ko cham yuj jun k'ak' to ayxo smay chi'? Tato ol kab' wal yoch sjaj Jehová ko Diosal jun'elxo, ol honh chamok.
Malaj wal junok anima syal yab'an yoch sjaj jun Dios pitzan t'a skal k'ak' icha ix kab' ha honh tik, yujto ay schamelal.
Wach' ha hach tzach och t'a yichanh Jehová ko Diosal chi' yik tzab'an masanil tas syala', slawi chi' tzalan t'ayonh masanil tas syal chi', ol ko k'anab'ajani, xe chi t'ayin.
Ayik wan heyalan chi' t'ayin, wan pax yab'an Jehová tas tzeyal chi', yuj chi' yal t'ayin: Toxo ix wab' tas syal jun chonhab' tik, ix scha hin k'o'ol tas ix yal heb'.
Komonok ichanhej tik spensar heb', aynhej welk'och t'a yol sat heb', sk'anab'ajannhej hin cheknab'il heb' yik wach' ol aj sb'eynhejb'at heb' yet' heb' yuninal t'a smasanil tiempo.
Yuj chi' al t'a heb' to smeltzaj heb' t'a scampamento.

Ha hachxo tik, kananh wet' t'a tik, yujto ol wal masanil hin cheknab'il t'ayach yet' hin k'ayb'ub'al, ol ha k'ayb'an heb' t'ay, yik wach' ol sb'eyb'alej heb' b'aj ay lum lum ol wak' chi' t'a heb', xchi Jehová chi' t'ayin.
Yuj chi' b'eyb'alejek masanil scheknab'il Jehová ko Diosal. Manh heyik'el t'a he pensar.
B'eyb'alejek b'eyb'al ix sch'oxkan Jehová ko Diosal, yik te wach'xonhej ol aj he b'eyb'ati, ol najatb'ok he k 'inal t'a sat lum lum ol yak' chi' t'ayex.
